name: Expenses
description:
Expenses is a personal spending tracker for Mac, iPhone, iPad, and Apple Vision Pro. It is designed around quickly recording an outlay, assigning the amount and currency, and using simple summaries to see where money is going.

The workflow is intentionally manual and lightweight. Add a purchase when it happens, review the resulting categories and trends later, and use the same record across Apple devices instead of maintaining a spreadsheet for small day-to-day decisions.

It is a tracker, not a bank-connected financial planner. That makes it a sensible choice for people who value quick entry, multiple currencies, and an account-free approach, but it also means the quality of the picture depends on entering transactions consistently.

## Features

- Add expenses quickly from the app to build a personal record of everyday spending without requiring registration.
- Review statistics and spending trends to spot category-level patterns over time.
- Track amounts in major currencies and customize exchange rates for travel or mixed-currency situations.
- Use the Mac, iPhone, iPad, and Apple Vision Pro versions as part of one Apple-focused spending workflow.
- Access Apple ecosystem conveniences such as widgets and Siri Shortcuts for faster entry and at-a-glance information.
- Use the app without it collecting personal data, according to the developer’s current privacy statement.

## Where it fits

Expenses fits a person or household that wants a calm manual log of discretionary spending without creating an account or adopting a full budgeting system. It is particularly useful for travel, cash purchases, or anyone trying to become more aware of habits before committing to a larger finance tool.

It will not automatically reconcile accounts or replace a bank, accountant, or complex shared budget. The insights are only as complete as the entries you add, so it is less suitable when automatic transaction imports are essential.
